description: Template: A = a PAIR (one composition in two interior colourways, one frame ratio), B = a pair for the Meta feed, C = a PACK (one design, one colour, one frame per destination ratio: stories 9:16, Meta feed 4:5, Pinterest 2:3). `for` names the destinations of specs/ad_formats.json; destinations with the same ratio share a frame; the name of a frame carries the platform (<set>_<pair><n>_<colour>_<platform>_<ratio>). At most 3 photos per pair (one board). Copy to specs/sets/<id>.json, change id, listing_spec and the choices; every name must exist in Promt/trends.json. Then: py -3.12 -X utf8 scripts/director.py plan <id>
